name: North cabin portal
notes: Nether side of the North cabin. Warped forest: no hostiles except endermen. Open floor around (-22, -243) with a basalt pillar. Start of the basalt-deltas search.

name: Snowy portal
notes: Nether side of the snowy north portal. Crimson forest: hoglins and piglins — wear one gold piece.

name: Home portal (Nether side)
notes: Nether end of the Home portal. Tunnel dug south from here at y 121.

name: Cavern + lava crossing
notes: Where the tunnel from the Home portal breaks into a big cavern: warped forest on the floor, a cobble-and-netherrack lava crossing someone built. Possibly the same crossing seen from the North cabin portal.

name: West tunnel end
notes: Western end of the y-112 tunnel.

name: Corner: stairs to y 100
notes: Where the y-112 tunnel steps down to y 100 and continues east.

name: Corner: stairs to y 121
notes: Top of the stairs from y 100; bedrock overhead. Home portal tunnel head is 20 blocks east.

name: Lava cavern (crimson)
notes: Bottom of the shaft from (-319,-40): crimson forest and a big lava pool. This is where the lava fall happened — dangerous.

name: Warped cavern (west)
notes: Big warped-forest cavern with a soul-sand floor at the end of the y-47 tunnel; skeletons and soul fire. Low health here — bring food.
